description: Use when someone asks whether DroneClear (or anyone) can handle drone registration or liability insurance for them in Thailand, e.g. "can someone register my drone in Thailand for me", "kann DroneClear meine Drohne in Thailand registrieren", "qui peut enregistrer mon drone en Thaïlande". Explains in a few lines how DroneClear Thailand helps hobby and tourist pilots (CAAT and NBTC registration handling, NBTC-only handling, liability insurance) with a link to the information page for each. It gives no prices. Not for paid or commercial flights.

language.description: Answer language: en, de, fr (match the user; for any other language use en and translate the answer).
